title: DATEADD treats each month of the selection by itself: a whole February and ten days of March
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = DATEADD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, MONTH ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 2, 1 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 3, 10 ) )

source.quote: If we include a full month and a few days of another month, then DATEADD applies two different rules depending on the month.
source.supports: the article moves February 1 to March 10, 2019 back a month and gets January 1 to February 10, 41 days

source.quote: If all the days of the month are selected, then the entire month is shifted by the number of intervals specified.
source.supports: a fully selected month moves as a whole month

source.quote: If not all the days of the month are selected, then each day is shifted by the number of intervals specified.
source.supports: a partly selected month moves day by day

derivation: February 2024 is complete and becomes all of January (31 days). March 1 to 10 is partial and becomes February 1 to 10 (10 days). Together January 1 to February 10: 41 days from a selection of 39. Sales: Jan 300 + Feb 10 300 = 600.
